resources.string: Connect directly and ignore system proxy settings
Use the system proxy configured by Wi-Fi or a VPN app
Set a proxy server, optional credentials and bypass rules
Prefer the system proxy, then detect common local proxy ports; connect directly if none are found
API requests, downloads, uploads and previews share this configuration. Bypassed hosts always connect directly.
Separate entries with commas or spaces. Domains include subdomains; * bypasses all hosts; <local> matches localhost and private addresses.
Automatic mode detects common local ports using HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5 handshakes and caches results for five minutes. A selected proxy failure does not fall back to a direct connection.
Save to apply to new requests. Existing requests keep their current route.
Bypass rules support domains, IP addresses, * and <local>
